name: Filing at the bell
when: An 8-K or other primary filing lands before the open, and premarket volume is at least 3x normal.
then: Queue call orders for the open on the filer and its neighbors. One contract per player, stop under the premarket low.
notes: The exception to never buying at the open. NVDA, Nov 23: the Form 8-K hit 33 minutes before the bell and the stock rallied 35%.

name: Dip on a firing
when: A leader exit drops the stock through a one-year support while contract volume climbs.
then: Buy calls on the far expiry (January, not the weekly). Tiny stake, the sensible version of the lotto.
notes: Someone knew. Volume on Thursday and Friday during the dip was the tell.

name: Follow the whales
when: A strike trades at 3x its open interest or more during a dip.
then: Ride it: one tranche in, ladder the exits.

name: Ask the models
when: A story reads bullish or bearish on a symbol.
then: Ask Gemini, Claude and ChatGPT for the best call or put contracts for that read. Keep only the contracts they agree on.

name: RSI snap-back
when: RSI(14) under 30 while price holds above its 200-day average.

name: Sell the quiet put
when: A one-year support holds and volume dries up.
then: Sell cash-secured puts below the support.
notes: Capital needs unchecked: price the collateral before this goes live.

name: Both sides of the coin
when: A dated catalyst is coming and the direction is a coin flip.
then: A small straddle or strangle, sized so the worst case is the stake.
notes: For steady returns, not lottery wins.

name: Odds under the news
when: A prediction-market price lags a confirmed filing or result.
then: Buy the side the news already decided, while the price is still behind.

name: Fade the run
when: A stock has run 30% or more in a month and its stretch reading is 60 or higher.
then: Look for puts or put spreads, ready to size up once the first support breaks. The stretch is the reason; the Greeks only pick the contract.
notes: NVDA, Nov 24: up 35% a day earlier, then red. Several AIs talked the trade down with theta and Greeks when the run itself was the signal.

name: Three outcomes first
when: A play or a story is being weighed.
then: Say up, flat and down with a probability each before choosing a contract. Pick the contract that pays in the likeliest two.
